issue_context.body:

- [x] This issue contains only one feature request. I will open one issue for every feature I want to request.

#### What feature do you want?
<!-- Explain how you want the app's look or behavior to change to suit your needs. -->
Confirming video deletion whenever a video is deleted from local playlists.

#### Why do you want this feature?
<!-- Describe any problem or limitation you come across while using the app which would be solved by this feature. -->

There might be a few videos whose thumbnail, link, and title are stored in the local playlist, but the video is not available. Accidental deletion can cause them to be lost forever with no way of revival. In fact thats why i made this feature request (lost a historic vid's link thats deleted)
comments:
Good Idea.

Confirmation of deletion is always useful, sometimes it saved from unwanted deletion.
I don't think this is necessary since we have the "restore" button when someone (accidentally) deletes a video.
I dont have any undo or restore button when i delete a video.

> I don't have any undo or restore button when i delete a video. Are you sure? That's not possible because I have one: and the code also says that you should have one when deleting a video: https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/2e538b89599cfb6225221d22f1aca3e8eaa758ba/app/src/main/java/us/shandian/giga/ui/common/Deleter.java#L94 Are using NewPipe to delete files?
@litetex The author is talking about playlist videos added by the user. Not downloads.
For consistency sake I would propose to have the same behaviour as deleting downloaded videos. So instantly delete it, but add a snackbar with the undo button

The code from the download section can't be used as is. Reason being that [Deleter.java](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/dev/app/src/main/java/us/shandian/giga/ui/common/Deleter.java) is tightly coupled to the download classes (see constructor parameters). From a first glance I also can't see how to easily resolve this.

Main functionality of that class is (I think)
1. handling everything asynchonously
1. delaying the deletion until the snackbar disappears
2. preventing stacking snackbars when deleting multiple things
https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/pull/8351 I try it to fix it in this PR .

review_comments: All of the actions below should also be done only if the user really wants the item to be removed
